newsitem.title: USA: MidAmerican Energy to reduce electric rates.
newsitem.headline: MidAmerican Energy to reduce electric rates.

text.p: MidAmerican Energy Co said Wednesday it will reduce residential electric prices by $10 million upon approval of the Iowa Utilities Board. It said the reduction was approved by the Iowa Office of Consumer Advocate and the Iowa Energy Consumers, a group of industrial consumers.
The utility reduced its residential prices in November by $8.5 million or three percent for about 71 percent of the company's Iowa residential customers.
Because of mergers, MidAmerican has three different price structures in Iowa. It will distribute this reduction among the price structures to reduce price differences.
According to the agreement, the company will further reduce its residential electric prices on June 1, 1998 by $5 million.

Under the proposed settlement agreement, MidAmerican will not seek an increase in its electric prices, excluding state-mandated program costs, before December 31, 2000, unless its earnings fall significantly below historic levels.
MidAmerican Energy serves customers in Iowa, Illinois, Nebraska and South Dakota.
